description: Compass, Axis & Time HUD — a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft that puts a clean compass ribbon, your coordinates, and the in-game clock right at the top of your screen.

mods.name: CAT HUD
mods.description: Compass, Axis & Time HUD. A compass ribbon plus your coordinates and the in-game time, rendered as plain text -- no action bar or boss bar involved.

releases.notes:
Initial release of customizable CAT HUD for Minecraft 26.2.

### Features:
- Smoothly scrolling compass ribbon.
- Fully customizable HUD scale and screen positioning offsets.
- Customizable text drop shadows (offsets & color opacity/alpha).
- Semi-transparent ribbon background strip.
- Separator lines flanking the center pointer.
- Unique color configurations for each cardinal direction (North, South, East, West).
